---
title: "Normalise cohort names"
author: "Isobel Beasley"
output: html_document
---

Aims: Want to take NER cohort annotations, and make them consistent across all papers, such that we can identify what papers are studying the same cohorts. 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Fixing any mistakes in labelling 

```{r fix_not_full_labels}

pad_to_words <- function(annot, sentence) {
    stringr::str_extract(
      sentence,
      paste0("[\\w'’-]*", stringr::str_escape(annot), "[\\w'’-]*")
    )
}

cohorts <- cohorts |>
    filter(cohort_annot != "") |>
    mutate(cohort_annot_full = pad_to_words(cohort_annot, sentence),
           cohort_annot_update = dplyr::coalesce(cohort_annot_full, cohort_annot) |>
             stringr::str_remove_all(pattern = "'s$|’s$|-based$|’$|-individuals$")  |>
             stringr::str_remove_all(pattern = "rapid-gwas-of-thousands-of-phenotypes-for-337000-samples-in-the-") |>
             stringr::str_remove_all(pattern = "study--")

    )

cohorts |>
    filter(cohort_annot_update != cohort_annot) |>
    distinct(cohort_annot_update, cohort_annot) |>
    head()

cohorts <-
    cohorts |>
    rename(cohort_annot_orig = cohort_annot,
           cohort_annot = cohort_annot_update
    ) |>
    select(-cohort_annot_full) |>
    distinct()

# drop weird annotations
cohorts <-
  cohorts |>
  filter(stringr::str_length(cohort_annot) != 1)

cohorts <-
  cohorts |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort_annot, delim = "; ") 



```

# Extract paper-specific abbreviations

```{bash ab3p_abbrev, eval = FALSE}

shopt -s nullglob
mkdir -p output/abbreviations
out=output/abbreviations/paper_ab3p_abbreviations.tsv
log=output/abbreviations/ab3p_stderr.log

printf 'pmid\tshort_form\tlong_form\tprecision\n' > "$out"
: > "$log"

for txt_file in output/abstracts/*.txt output/results_copy/*.txt output/methods_copy/*.txt; do
    filename=$(basename "$txt_file")
    if [[ "$filename" =~ ^([0-9]+) ]]; then
        pmid="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"

        clean=$(mktemp /tmp/ab3p.XXXXXX)
        # iconv -f UTF-8 -t ASCII//TRANSLIT -c < "$txt_file" \
        #    | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/  */ /g; s/ $//' > "$clean"
        # echo >> "$clean"
        
        iconv -f UTF-8 -t ASCII//TRANSLIT -c < "$txt_file" \
            | tr '_' '-' \
            | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/  */ /g; s/ $//' > "$clean"
            echo >> "$clean"

        apptainer run -B /tmp ab3p.sif "$clean" 2>>"$log" |
        awk -F'|' -v pmid="$pmid" '
            /^  / && NF == 3 {
                sf = $1; gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", sf)
                lf = $2; gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/, "", lf)
                if ($3 + 0 > 0.9) print pmid "\t" sf "\t" lf "\t" $3 + 0
            }' >> "$out"

        rm -f "$clean"
    else
        echo "No leading PMID: $txt_file" >&2
    fi
done

wc -l "$out" # ~22,000 abbreviations

grep -c 'Failed to find sentence' "$log"  # ~16702

```


```{r}

ab3p_abbrev <- data.table::fread(here::here("output/abbreviations/paper_ab3p_abbreviations.tsv"),
                                 sep = "\t",
                                 quote = "")


abbrev_map  <-
ab3p_abbrev |>
  rename(cohort_annot = short_form,
         pubmed_id = pmid
         )  |>
  select(-precision)

cohorts <-
    cohorts |>
    tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort_annot, delim = ";") |>
    mutate(cohort_annot = stringr::str_squish(cohort_annot))

cohorts <-
left_join(
  cohorts,
  abbrev_map,
by = c("pubmed_id", "cohort_annot"),
relationship = "many-to-many"
) |>
  mutate(long_form = ifelse(is.na(long_form),
                       cohort_annot,
                       long_form
                       )
  )

cohorts  |>
  distinct(long_form) |>
  nrow()

data.table::fwrite(cohorts, 
                   "training_papers_test.csv",
                   sep = ",")

# now check for cohorts in the same pubmed that are one word different,
```

```{r load_final_normalised_names}

# normalised cohort names
cohort_norm <- data.table::fread(here::here("training_papers_test_cohort_norm.csv"))

cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>
  filter(not_cohort == FALSE) 

# remove probable reference cohort mentions
cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>
filter(!grepl("imputation|imputed|panel|reference", sentence, ignore.case = T)) |>
filter(!grepl("\\bLD\\b", sentence)) |>
filter(!grepl("\\blinkage disequilbrium\\b", sentence)) 

cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>
filter(!grepl(" HapMap3 (SNPs|variants)", sentence)) 

cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>
filter(
  !(
  grepl("gnomAD", sentence) & 
  grepl("minor allele|MAF| allele frequencies|AF|annotated|variant statistics", sentence)
  )
)

cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>
  filter(!cohort_annot %in% c("ukbbs", "gefos", "ukbb", "scapis"))


# drop software 
cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>
  filter(
    !(cohort_annot == "GENESIS" & grepl("GENESIS package|GENESIS R package", sentence))
  ) |>
  filter(
    !(cohort_annot == "GENESIS" & pubmed_id %in% c("31217584",

  )

cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>

    !(cohort_annot == "MACS" & grepl("MACS version|called peaks using MACS|MACS Miltenyl Biotec", sentence))
  ) 

cohort_norm <-
cohort_norm  |>

                              long_form,

cohort_names <- readxl::read_xlsx(here::here("data/cohort/cohort_desc_v3_sep17.xlsx"),

    )

cohort_norm <- 
left_join(
  cohort_norm,

cohort_norm <-

  distinct(pubmed_id,

cohort_norm |>

  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort_group, delim = "Biobank, ") |>
  tidyr::separate_longer_delim(cohort_norm, delim = "/") |>

  mutate(cohort_group = case_when(

    cohort_group == "DIAGRAMv3" ~ "Diabetes Genetics Replication and Meta-analysis Consortium",
```

```{r}

# reintroduce year into cohorts data frame
gwas_paper_data <- data.table::fread(here::here("output/gwas_cat/gwas_study_info_trait_cat.csv"),
                                     select = c("PUBMED_ID", "YEAR")) |>
                   dplyr::rename_with(~tolower(.x)) |>
                   distinct()

# count number of papers per year
gwas_paper_data <-
  gwas_paper_data |>
  group_by(year) |>
  mutate(n_paper_year = n()) |>
  ungroup()

cohort_norm <-
left_join(cohort_norm,
          gwas_paper_data,
          by = c("pubmed_id"))


# pick cohorts to highlight
increasing_cohorts <-
cohort_norm |>
  filter(cohort_group != "Other") |>
  distinct(year, cohort_group, n_paper_year, pubmed_id) |>
  group_by(year, cohort_group) |>
  summarise(prop_paper = n()/unique(n_paper_year),
            .groups = "drop"
            ) |>
  tidyr::complete(year, cohort_group, fill = list(prop_paper = 0)) |>
  arrange(cohort_group, year) |>
  group_by(cohort_group) |>
  summarise(non_decreasing_years = sum(diff(prop_paper) >= 0)) |>
  filter(non_decreasing_years > 14) |>
  pull(cohort_group)


# pick cohorts to highlight
decreasing_cohorts <-
cohort_norm |>
  filter(cohort_group != "Other") |>
  distinct(year, cohort_group, n_paper_year, pubmed_id) |>
  group_by(year, cohort_group) |>
  summarise(prop_paper = n()/unique(n_paper_year),
            .groups = "drop"
            ) |>
  tidyr::complete(year, cohort_group, fill = list(prop_paper = 0)) |>
  arrange(cohort_group, year) |>
  group_by(cohort_group) |>
  summarise(decreasing_years = sum(diff(prop_paper) <= 0)) |>
  filter(decreasing_years > 14) |>
  pull(cohort_group)
  

# cohort that were top three in any year, and had more than one paper in that year
top_cohorts <-
cohort_norm  |>
  filter(cohort_group != "Other") |>
  distinct(year, cohort_group, pubmed_id) |>
  group_by(year, cohort_group) |>
  summarise(n_paper = n()) |>
  slice_max(n_paper,
            n = 3,
            with_ties = TRUE) |>
  filter(n_paper > 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pull(cohort_group)  |>
  unique()

multi_year_cohorts <-
cohort_norm  |>
  filter(cohort_group != "Other") |>
  distinct(cohort_group, year) |>
  group_by(cohort_group) |>
  summarise(n = n()) |>
  filter(n > 3) |>
  pull(cohort_group)

cohort_norm  |>
  filter(year < 2010) |>
  distinct(cohort_group, year, pubmed_id) |>
  count(cohort_group) |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |> slice_max(n = 5, order_by = n)

cohort_norm  |>
  filter(year >= 2010 & year < 2015) |>
  distinct(cohort_group, year, pubmed_id) |>
  count(cohort_group) |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |> 
  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = n)

cohort_norm  |>
  filter(year >= 2015 & year < 2020) |>
  distinct(cohort_group, year, pubmed_id) |>
  count(cohort_group) |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |> 
  slice_max(n = 5, order_by = n)

cohort_norm  |>
  filter(year > 2020) |>
  distinct(cohort_group, year, pubmed_id) |>
  count(cohort_group) |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |> slice_max(n = 4, order_by = n)





intersect(top_cohorts, multi_year_cohorts)

intersect(top_cohorts, increasing_cohorts)

intersect(top_cohorts, decreasing_cohorts)
```

```{r}
cohorts_plot_df  <-
  cohort_norm |>
  select(pubmed_id, 
         year, 
         n_paper_year,
         cohort_group) |>
  mutate(cohort = ifelse(cohort_group %in% selected_cohorts,
                         cohort_group,
                         "Other")) |>
  select(-cohort_group) |>
  distinct()

cohorts_plot_df <-
  cohorts_plot_df  |>
  group_by(year, cohort) |>
  summarise(N_papers = n(),
            n_paper_year = unique(n_paper_year)) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~stringr::str_to_title(.x))


# pick factor ordering 
cohort_order <- 
cohorts_plot_df |>
  group_by(Cohort) |>
  summarise(total = sum(N_papers)) |>
  arrange(desc(total)) |>
  pull(Cohort)

# make sure other is last: 
cohort_order <- c("Other", cohort_order[cohort_order != "Other"])


cohorts_plot_df <-
  cohorts_plot_df  |>
  mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = cohort_order))
```

```{r}
  # geom_col(aes(y= N_paper_year,
```

  # scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(from = min(cohorts_plot_df$Year),
  #                                 to = max(cohorts_plot_df$Year),
  #                                 by = 2),
  #                                 expand = c(0.02, 0)
  #                    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(from = min(cohorts_plot_df$Year),
                                  to = max(cohorts_plot_df$Year),
                                  by = 1),
                     labels = function(x) ifelse((x - min(cohorts_plot_df$Year)) %% 2 == 0, x, "")
                     # expand = c(0.02, 0)
                     ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(from = 0,
                                  to = cohorts_plot_df |>
                                       group_by(Year) |>
                                       summarise(total = sum(N_papers)) |>
                                       slice_max(total, with_ties = FALSE) |>
                                       pull(total) + 10,
                                  by = 20),
                     limits = c(0,
                                cohorts_plot_df |>
                                       group_by(Year) |>
                                       summarise(total = sum(N_papers)) |>
                                       slice_max(total, with_ties = FALSE) |>
                                       pull(total) + 10),
                                  expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_bw() +
  #theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -30, hjust = 0)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = mapped_cohort_colours ,
                      name = "Cohort",
                      labels = scales::label_wrap(20)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mapped_cohort_colours ,
                      name = "Cohort",
                     labels = scales::label_wrap(20)) +
  #   scale_fill_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set3",
  #                   labels = scales::label_wrap(20)) +
  # scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set3",
  #                    labels = scales::label_wrap(20)) +
  labs(y = "Number of Papers",
       x = "Publication Year") + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next"),
    
     ####### axis labels and ticks:  ##########
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "in"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 25,
                                colour = "black"
                                # margin = margin(t = 0.1,
                                #                 unit = "in")
                                ),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 25,
                                colour = "black"), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25,
                                colour = "black",
                                margin = margin(t = 0.2,
                                                unit = "in")), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25,
                                colour = "black"), 
    
    
     ############ Legend text + options ##########
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 25,
                                colour = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = 0, 
                               unit = "in"),
    legend.key.spacing.x = unit(10, "pt"),
    
    
    
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.margin = margin(
                         t = 0, # top
                         r = 0,
                         b = 0,  # bottom
                         l = 0, # left
                         unit = "in"),

    panel.border = element_blank(), 
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed"),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(colour = "grey60", linetype = "dashed"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x =  element_blank()
    )

ggsave(plot,
       filename =here::here("figures/cohort_mentions_overtime.png"),
       device = ragg::agg_png,
       dpi = 440,
       width = 12.3,
       height = 5.8,
       units = "in"
)
